LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.0.label: Aphrodisiac Corrosion: Warmth
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.0.description: A warmth is spreading from within. I want a little more, but I can still hold it back.
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.1.label: Aphrodisiac Corrosion: Arousal
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.1.description: The heat has spread through my whole body. I keep thinking about it, and concentrating is difficult.
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.2.label: Aphrodisiac Corrosion: Intoxication
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.2.description: Things in front of me are blurring and sounds are ringing in my ears. I cannot tell what is real.
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.3.label: Aphrodisiac Corrosion: Indulgence
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.3.description: Desire has overwhelmed me. I no longer care what I am doing, and I cannot control myself.
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.4.label: Aphrodisiac Corrosion: Bliss
LanguageData.PNA_Debuff_Thought.stages.4.description: I can barely hold on. There is only pleasure left in my head, and nothing else.
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.0.label: Aphrodisiac Activation: Clarity
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.0.descr: It is as if my body has lit up. Suddenly, everything feels clear.
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.1.label: Aphrodisiac Activation: Lightness
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.1.descr: My limbs feel light and my movements keep pace with my thoughts. My body obeys me better than usual.
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.2.label: Aphrodisiac Activation: Vitality
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.2.descr: Strength and desire are rising together. I feel excited and clear-headed.
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.3.label: Aphrodisiac Activation: Exhilaration
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.3.descr: My body is burning. I feel stronger than ever, and I cannot stop.
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.4.label: Aphrodisiac Activation: Euphoria
LanguageData.SSC_PnaRootedLoad_Thought.stages.4.descr: This strength is almost more than I can contain. It feels so good that I want it to last forever.
